description: Get full details for a specific quantum computing job by its numeric ID. Use after searchJobs when the user wants more information about a specific position. Returns: job summary, required skills, nice-to-have skills, responsibilities, visa sponsorship, salary, location, and apply URL. Requires a valid job_id from searchJobs results. Returns error if ID not found.

job_id.description: Numeric job ID from searchJobs results

name: getJobDetails
title: Job Details
